profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Seasoned IT professional, experienced in software and database development, application support and  technical documentation. Adaptable to new challenges, self-motivated and eager to learn new technologies and skills.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Development  and maintenance of applications for the health insurance industry, for applications written in C# and VB6, as well as creation of SQL Scripts in SQL Server. Technologies used.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Development and Support of applications for a financial institution, using C# .NET Core and SQL Server. Tasks included creation and modification of applications as well as writing and preparing deployment documents for CI/CD.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Develop and provide support and develop new applications for the IT Infrastructure department at Samsung Austin Semiconductor. Tasks include fixing issues with both application and database issues, extending features on existing applications and creating new ones. Technologies used include:

•	Visual Studio 2012, ASP .NET MVC, C#, JQuery and LINQ.
•	SQL Server and Oracle for database systems.
•	Telerik controls for ASP .NET development.
•	SVN for source control.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Support for existing applications.
ASP .NET, to modify and expand features of existing web applications.
JavaScript, to improve client side validations.
SQL Server 2012, to write stored procedures and improve reporting applications.

positions.title: Database and Applications Specialist
positions.description:
Development of ETL processes with C#.
Development of applications using:
   C# in Visual Studio (MS Excel applications)
   Windows Communication Foundation
   ASP.NET with AJAX
Creation of Stored Procedures in SQL server.
Automated data extraction from Sharepoint lists.
Intensive remote work with teams in China, India, and Singapore.
Knowledge transfer on designed applications to support team.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
C# development for back end, using Visual Studio 2010. Creation of plugins for existing WCF project using parallel programming with TPL.
Custom ETL solution with C#, using Task Parallel Library.
Use of Dev Express components.
Use of PL/SQL for basic queries in Oracle11g, and T-SQL for SQL Server.
Creation of templates for reporting tasks.
Development of end user documentation on designed application.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
Programming with C# for ASP .NET applications, using Visual Studio 2005 and 2010.
    Creation of Stored Procedures and Ad Hoc queries with SQL Server 2008.
    Maintenance of existing web applications for internal operations and management.
    Maintenance of SQL Server Databases used for ASP applications.
    Heavy use of AJAX .NET for enhanced user experience with web applications.
    Development in JavaScript for client side validations and enhanced user experience.
    ETL with SQL Integration Services and creation of basic cubes for SQL Server Analysis Services.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Development of Windows Applications with C# in Visual Studio 2005.
Creation of complex queries with SQL Server 2005.
Design and implementation of both windows and web applications for Data Reporting for product distribution. 
Windows and ASP development in Visual Studio .NET in C# 2005.
Continuous development of reporting applications for MySql and SQL Server Database Systems. 
Development of reports in Sharp-Shooter Report and Crystal Reports.
Agile methodologies (SCRUM).

positions.title: Applications Engineer
positions.description:
Web Application Development with Visual Basic .NET, ASP .NET and ASP 3.0. 
Development of ASP .NET intranet application for evidence items inventory for the Crime Scene Investigation division at the Dallas Police Department.
Stored Procedures development with T-SQL in SQL Server 2000.
Database Design and Administration in SQL Server 2000.

positions.title: CIC Agent
positions.description: Technical support for Acer laptops in both English and Spanish.  Translation and creation of online and printed technical information for Spanish support.  Development of web applications for the Acer Latin America division.

positions.title: GSC Project Development and Management Team
positions.description:
Daily data analysis on information regarding service calls and other internal operations. 
Development of internal applications for information management with Windows applications, Web Services and Stored Procedures, created with Visual Basic, ASP .NET and SQL Server 2000.
Translation of technical manuals and official documents to and from English and Spanish.

positions.title: Bilingual Technical Support Agent
positions.description: Technical Support Department for DELL Latin America, providing bilingual technical advice in English and Spanish and troubleshooting Dimension, Optiplex, Inspiron and Latitude systems for home users in Latin America and the Caribbean.
